concept: Running LLM models locally on a Mac
summary: Cited expert reference on running llm models locally on mac: 502 researched concepts in 21 clusters.

facts.text: grep `topics/*/llms-facts.txt` for exact terms; read `topics/<key>/llms-full.txt` by line range.
`llms-facts.txt` here holds every CONTRADICTS correction.
Ollama v0.40.0-rc0 runs Apple-silicon models on MLX with no tag suffix; no opt-out flag named.
llama-server `/health` stays 200 after a Metal failure; real failure is HTTP 500 "Compute error."; probe with a completion and SIGKILL.
Wired cap is `iogpu.wired_limit_mb`; a missing key silently does nothing, 0 restores default, resets on reboot.
Kernel panic `completeMemory() prepare count underflow` at `IOGPUMemory.cpp:550` on long prefill; mitigate with mlx-lm 0.31.0 and a wired limit below RAM.
Decode is bandwidth-bound: M5 Max 460 GB/s (32-core GPU) or 614 GB/s (40-core).
KLD: `llama-perplexity --kl-divergence-base f`, then `--kl-divergence`; compare at equal GiB (q4_0 4.34 GiB is 67% worse than q4_K_S 4.37).
Claude Code's `x-anthropic-billing-header ... cch=` breaks prefix caching; llama.cpp rewrites it (PR 21793); else `CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0` in settings env.
Codex needs `/v1/responses`; `model_auto_compact_token_limit_scope` is `total` (default) or `body_after_prefix`.
JACCL needs a full Thunderbolt mesh and `MLX_METAL_FAST_SYNCH=1`; mlx 0.32.3 fixes a fence deadlock (PR 4552).
ANE is FP16-only; activations above 65,504 overflow.
Pin llama.cpp commit and mlx-lm version, same bpw, greedy batch 1; report median of runs 2-4.
